# sspi_installer_recurring_backup_config (Resource)

Manages automated recurring backup schedule for SSPI.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether automated recurring backups are enabled.

### Optional

- `backup_schedule_interval` (Attributes) Interval schedule settings. Required when `backup_schedule_type = INTERVAL`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_schedule_interval))
- `backup_schedule_type` (String) Schedule type: `WEEKLY` (calendar days/time) or `INTERVAL` (hours between runs).
- `backup_schedule_weekly` (Attributes) Weekly schedule settings. Required when `backup_schedule_type = WEEKLY` — the live API rejects `WEEKLY` without it (`"weekly backup schedule not found for schedule type WEEKLY"`). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--backup_schedule_weekly))
- `backup_type` (String) Type of backup (e.g. FULL_BACKUP).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for recurring backup configuration (always 'singleton').

<a id="nestedatt--backup_schedule_interval"></a>

### Nested Schema for `backup_schedule_interval`

Optional:

- `hours_between_backups` (Number) Hours between consecutive automated backups. Defaults to `168` (weekly).

<a id="nestedatt--backup_schedule_weekly"></a>

### Nested Schema for `backup_schedule_weekly`

Required:

- `days_of_week` (List of String) Days of week when backup runs (e.g. `["MONDAY", "THURSDAY"]`).

Optional:

- `hour_of_day` (Number) Hour of day (0-23) when the backup starts. Defaults to `0`.
- `minute_of_day` (Number) Minute within the hour (0-59) when the backup starts. Defaults to `0`.
